variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Dedoc is an open-source system that converts documents from different formats into a unified structured representation. It can extract textual lines in reading order, format annotations, hierarchy, tables, attachments, and metadata. It can run as a Python library, an API service, or a container.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “What is Dedoc?”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Content
pairs.detail: Textual lines and annotations preserve what was read and enough formatting context to render or inspect it.
pairs.explanation: Textual lines and annotations preserve what was read and enough formatting context to render or inspect it.

pairs.label: Structure
pairs.detail: Line types and hierarchy levels are constructed into a tree or a linear output, depending on the requested representation.
pairs.explanation: Line types and hierarchy levels are constructed into a tree or a linear output, depending on the requested representation.

pairs.label: Objects
pairs.detail: Tables, attachments, and metadata remain separate objects so downstream code does not have to reconstruct them from flattened prose.

variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Follow the documented parsing pipeline”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Convert when needed
pairs.detail: Normalize formats that can be converted to a supported representation, such as older office documents to their newer container formats.
pairs.explanation: Normalize formats that can be converted to a supported representation, such as older office documents to their newer container formats.

pairs.label: Read the document
pairs.detail: Produce an intermediate document with lines, annotations, tables, attachments, and metadata.
pairs.explanation: Produce an intermediate document with lines, annotations, tables, attachments, and metadata. PDF routing may use native text, image recognition, or page-level detection.

pairs.label: Extract structure
pairs.detail: Assign line types and hierarchy levels using a domain-specific extractor or the default structure path.
pairs.explanation: Assign line types and hierarchy levels using a domain-specific extractor or the default structure path.

pairs.label: Construct output
pairs.detail: Build a tree or linear representation, serialize it in the requested format, and retain source lineage for review.
pairs.explanation: Build a tree or linear representation, serialize it in the requested format, and retain source lineage for review.
